title: Hell House LLC Origins The Carmichael Manor
titleEn: Hell House LLC Origins The Carmichael Manor
description: Hell House LLC Origins: The Carmichael Manor is a 2023 American direct-to-streaming found footage horror film written and directed by Stephen Cognetti. It simultaneously serves as a prequel to Hell House LLC (2015) and a sequel to both Hell House LLC II: The Abaddon Hotel (2018) and Hell House LLC III: Lake of Fire (2019), and is the fourth installment overall in the Hell House LLC franchise. Produced by Joe BandelliI, it stars Bridget Rose Perrotta, Destiny Leilani Brown, James Liddell.
